from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetricRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric extracted from a company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The name of the line item in the report")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of currency (e.g., '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetricRecord]
